shortDescription: On Polymarket, the “Yes” option in the “Bitcoin Breaks Through on November 1” market’s “78,000” submarket climbed to 67.45%. According to ChainCatcher, the odds were 44.05% one hour earlier, a reported increase of 23.4%.
